edges.rationale: File declares and default-exports the ExamsNew function component.
File defines and named-exports getCategoryConfig for category UI mapping.
File declares the ExamCard sub-component used for both grid and list renders.
useEffect on mount invokes fetchData; retry button also calls it on error.
onToggleBookmark prop passed to ExamCard is the toggleBookmark callback.
filteredExams and categoryStats both consume processedExams as their input.
Rendered ExamCard list iterates filteredExams in the filtered/all-category view.
Sidebar and category cards read categoryStats[id].totalExams/totalTests/totalUsers.
fetchData awaits getExamCategories/getExams/getTestSeries/getPublicStats from dataService.
Initial bookmark set is loaded from localStorage.getItem(bookmarkedExams).
Each toggle persists the new array via localStorage.setItem(bookmarkedExams, ...).
ExamCard (grid + list) wraps content in Link to /exam-info/${exam.examId}.
Bookmark button onClick calls onToggleBookmark(exam.examId).
Falls back to MODERN_GRADIENTS[index % len] and MODERN_ICONS[index % len] when category has no color/icon.
Each exam is decorated via getCategoryConfig(category, index) for label/icon/color.
Active-filter chip label re-invokes getCategoryConfig for the selected category to show its human name.
Expanded filter panel iterates Object.entries(filterOptions) to render selects.
useAuth() supplies the user object that drives the Your Progress sidebar card.
Top breadcrumb is rendered with Home > Exam Categories items.
Hero section wraps title/subtitle inside AnimatedHero pageType=exams compact.
useSearchParams syncs ?q= and ?category= into URL; Link/useNavigate enable navigation.
Many lucide icons are rendered inline (Search, Grid, List, SlidersHorizontal, RefreshCw, Bookmark, etc.).
The Browse by Category + per-category exam sections are rendered when selectedCategory==all.
Category cards display stats.totalExams / totalTests / totalUsers from categoryStats.
Per-category sections render up to 4 ExamCard components in a 4-col grid.
Quick Links card is part of the sidebar block.
Each quick link is a Link navigating to /test-series, /live-tests, /pyps, /study.
filteredExams switch on sortBy implements the four documented sort strategies.
The four sort strategies (popular/name/upcoming/tests) live inside the filteredExams switch.
SearchBox is imported but never referenced in JSX, suggesting dead code.
